subject: Onshore/offshore DPA + transfer-impact addendum — kickoff and redline path
messages:
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@medicorelabs.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procure@medicorelabs.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines + SCCs — onshore/offshore transfer-impact addendum

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to get the contract items queued so legal can start reviewing. Attached are our initial DPA redlines (tracked) and the SCCs template we prefer to use. Main asks from our side: 

- We need an explicit Transfer Impact Addendum that lists onshore (US) processing for admin services and EU processing for model inference, and clarifies any offshore access (Philippines operations team) to customer identifiers.
- Proposed clause: vendor will not transfer EU personal data outside the EU other than as set out in the TIA; onshore subprocessors require documented risk mitigations.
- Evidence requests: SOC 2 Type II summary and subprocessor inventory (we included a short worksheet).

Can you confirm Redwood’s position on the TIA approach and whether you can accept our SCCs template with the minimal edits noted in the file? We have a procurement timeline: signed order form + DPA within three weeks to meet July product onboarding.

Attachments: MediCore_DPA_redlines_v1.docx, SCCs_signed_template.pdf, medicore_prod_subprocessor_inventory.xlsx

Thanks,
Samantha Nguyen
Head of Procurement, MediCore Labs
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@medicorelabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs — onshore/offshore transfer-impact addendum

Hi Samantha — thanks for the materials and clear asks. Looping in Karthik (privacy counsel) and Ben (sales lead) and Laura (contracts ops) so we can coordinate redlines and evidence. Quick initial responses: 

- We can follow your approach of a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) that enumerates processing locations and subprocessors. We typically include a binding paragraph that permits limited offshore operational access for support/observability under specific controls; Karthik please confirm exact language we should propose.
- SCCs: we can accept your template with two changes (liability paragraph + processor instructions) — will track edits.
- Evidence: SOC 2 summary is available; subprocessor inventory we will reconcile with our internal list and return an updated workbook.

Internal ask: Karthik, can you prepare a proposed redline to the MediCore doc with the TIA stub and the minimal SCCs edits by EOD Wed (2025-07-16)? Laura — after that we should produce a redline bundle and a short cover note for Procurement. Ben — FYI for deal timeline and whether we can commit to the three-week target.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik prepares redline + TIA stub (due 2025-07-16 EOD)
2) Internal legal + contracts review (Laura) by 2025-07-17 midday
3) Send counter-redline + evidence pack to MediCore and book a 30-min sync if MediCore wants to walk through any items

Happy to jump on a quick call with Procurement if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@medicorelabs.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: procure@medicorelabs.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs — onshore/offshore transfer-impact addendum

On Mon, Jul 14, 2025 at 11:03 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samantha — thanks for the materials and clear asks. Looping in Karthik (privacy counsel) and Ben (sales lead) and Laura (contracts ops) so we can coordinate redlines and evidence.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from our side: 
- The primary EU dataset contains limited personal data (customer names + login identifiers) and will remain in EU regions; inference may occur in multiple regions for latency reasons but we require contractual limits.
- We will need a subsection in the TIA that lists which subprocessors are allowed to access identifiers for debugging (e.g., monitoring, incident triage). Any offshore personnel access must be logged and limited.

Procurement is available for a 30-min call Thurs (2025-07-17) 10:00–11:00 CET or Fri morning CET. Also if you can include the SOC 2 summary and a redline by tomorrow midday that would be ideal.

Samantha
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@medicorelabs.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs — onshore/offshore transfer-impact addendum

Samantha — thanks for the clarifications and the call availability. Per Monica’s plan, we prepared a counter-redline bundle and a short TIA draft that accomplishes the following (attached in the return package):

- TIA: enumerates processing locations (EU inference region(s); US admin/onboarding region) and a narrowly-scoped clause permitting logged, role-based offshore access for specific operational tasks; requires documented mitigations for offshore subprocessors (access controls, logging, local data minimization).
- SCCs: accepted your template with two tracked edits (narrowing instruction scope + adding explicit audit rights for the controller).
- Evidence pack: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), current subprocessor list, and a reconciled copy of the medicore_prod_subprocessor_inventory.xlsx with our notes.

We believe these edits should address your procurement concerns while keeping the TIA precise. Proposed timeline: send this counter-redline + evidence bundle via HubSpot + DocuSign by EOD Fri (2025-07-18) if no major objections.

If you want to run the TIA language on your privacy team we can hold the DocuSign step until you confirm. Otherwise, Ben — please confirm whether we commit to the three-week onboarding target once procurement signs the order form. Laura, I’ve included a short redline summary doc for your operations checklist.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_counter_redline_DPA_v1.docx; TIA_draft_medicore.pdf; SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf; reconciled_subprocessor_inventory.xlsx
